verdict.rationale: Masking or redacting sensitive data in traces is a fair question for an LLM tracing and observability product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers OTLP ingestion, auto-instrumentation, tracing decorators and self-hosting, but never documents masking, redaction or hiding of span inputs/outputs before storage. Self-hosting that keeps data within your own infrastructure is an adjacent control and earns no credit for this story.
